about.heroTitle: We Are Here to Make Reservations Easier
about.heroSubtitle: CheckRezerve was born from the question business owners were asking: "Why is reservation management so cumbersome?" We are a small but determined team.
about.storyP1: It all started in Istanbul in late 2024, with a restaurant owner asking "a customer made a reservation but didn't show up — what do I do?" That person became our first advisor; together we deeply understood both the problem and the solution.
about.storyP2: Existing solutions were either too expensive or unfamiliar with Turkish business dynamics. We decided to build a platform from scratch that solves the real problems of local businesses.
about.storyP3: Today we have a solid product and we're connecting it with the right people. We don't talk big numbers — we prefer to be honest. We believe we'll grow together.
about.missionDesc: To enable businesses of all sizes in Turkey to deliver world-class reservation experiences. To make complex technology simple, accessible, and affordable.
about.visionDesc: To become Turkey's most trusted reservation management platform by 2027; then expand to the Middle East and Balkan markets.
about.earlyStageDesc: We're in early stages and growing fast. Together with our pilot customers, we build a stronger platform every day.

about.value2Desc: Delivering every promised feature on time is our priority.

privacy.title: CheckRezerve Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: This privacy policy relates to personal data processed by the CheckRezerve application (hereinafter "Application"). The Application has been developed to enable restaurants to accept online reservations.
privacy.s2Intro: The Application processes the following personal data:
privacy.s2Item2: To send confirmation and reminder notifications.
privacy.s2Item3: Date, time, number of guests, special requests.
privacy.s2Item4: WhatsApp/SMS messages are analysed only when the AI feature is used.
privacy.s3Item3: Business occupancy and reporting analytics for restaurants, hairdressers/barbers, spas, beauty salons, and fitness/pilates studios (no personal data included).
privacy.s4Intro: Your personal data is not shared with third parties for commercial purposes. It may only be shared with the following sub-processors for service delivery:
privacy.s4Item1: Database infrastructure (USA, data processing agreement in place).
privacy.s4Item2: SMS and WhatsApp notifications (USA, processed under SCCs).
privacy.s4Item3: AI message analysis (USA; message content is retained for 0 days).
privacy.s5Body: Reservation data is retained for 2 years unless the relevant restaurant requests otherwise or legal obligations require it. SMS/WhatsApp notification logs are deleted after 90 days.
privacy.s6Body: All data is transmitted over TLS/SSL encrypted connections. Database access is restricted through service role keys. Admin and restaurant panels require authentication.
privacy.s7Intro: Under applicable data protection law, you have the following rights:
privacy.s7Item1: The right to know whether your personal data is being processed.
privacy.s7Item2: The right to request information if it is being processed.
privacy.s7Item3: The right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
privacy.s7Item4: The right to request erasure of your personal data.
privacy.s7Item5: The right to request restriction of processing.
privacy.s7ContactPrefix: To exercise your rights, you may write to
privacy.s8Body: The Application uses only httpOnly secure cookies for session management. No analytics or advertising cookies are used.
privacy.s9Body: This policy will be updated upon significant changes and announced through the application. The current date is always shown at the top of the page.
privacy.s11Body: You may permanently delete your account at any time. When deleted, your profile, reservation history, and all personal data are permanently removed from our systems.
privacy.s11Step1: In the mobile app, go to Profile → Settings → Delete My Account.
privacy.s11Step2: Alternatively, send an email with subject "Account deletion request" to info@checkrezerve.com.
privacy.s11Step3: Your request will be processed within 7 business days and your account will be permanently deleted.
privacy.s11Note: Data subject to legal retention obligations (e.g. invoicing records) may be retained anonymously until the statutory retention period expires.

kvkk.title: Personal Data Protection and Processing Policy
kvkk.intro: CheckRezerve Teknoloji ("CheckRezerve") is committed to protecting the personal data of our users and business partners with the utmost care and fulfils all obligations as data controller under applicable data protection law.
kvkk.s1Title: 1. Your Personal Data and How We Collect It
kvkk.s1Body: Personal data refers to any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person. Your name, surname, phone number, email address and business information are processed within the scope of applicable data protection law. This data is obtained when you use our platform, complete an application form, or contact us.
kvkk.s2Title: 2. Purposes for Which Your Personal Data Is Processed
kvkk.s2Intro: At CheckRezerve, we process your personal data for the following purposes:
kvkk.s2Item1: To fulfil our obligations in connection with the service you receive from our platform
kvkk.s2Item2: To monitor and manage reservation and business processes
kvkk.s2Item3: To provide services within the scope of our business activities and to improve quality
kvkk.s2Item4: To inform you about campaigns and innovations (with your explicit consent)
kvkk.s2Outro: Your data will be deleted, destroyed or anonymised by us when the purpose of processing has ceased or when the retention period required by applicable legislation has expired.
kvkk.s3Title: 3. Your Rights as a Data Subject
kvkk.s3Intro: As a data subject, you have the following rights under applicable data protection law:
kvkk.s3Item1: The right to know whether your personal data is being processed
kvkk.s3Item2: The right to request information if your personal data has been processed
kvkk.s3Item3: The right to know the purpose of processing and whether it is being used in accordance with that purpose
kvkk.s3Item4: The right to know the third parties to whom your data has been transferred, whether domestically or abroad
kvkk.s3Item5: The right to request correction if your data is incomplete or inaccurate
kvkk.s3Item6: The right to request deletion or destruction under applicable law
kvkk.s3Item7: The right to object to decisions arising from the analysis of your data by automated systems
kvkk.s3Item8: The right to claim compensation for damages incurred due to unlawful processing
kvkk.s4Body: You may submit requests regarding your rights by emailing
kvkk.s4BodyEnd: Your request will be answered within 30 days.

cerezPolitikasi.title: Cookie Notice
cerezPolitikasi.s1Body: Cookies are small text files that websites you visit save to your browser. These files help the site recognise you and remember your preferences. Cookies are either session cookies (deleted when the browser is closed) or persistent cookies (stored for a specified period).
cerezPolitikasi.s2MandatoryBody: These are necessary for the site's core functions to operate. They cannot be disabled. Session management, security verification and page redirects fall within this category.
cerezPolitikasi.s2PerformanceBody: These help us understand how you use the site. Visit counts, page viewing duration and error reports are collected through tools such as Google Analytics. The data collected is anonymised.
cerezPolitikasi.s2FunctionalBody: These remember your preferences. Language selection, session information and personalisation options are preserved through these cookies. If disabled, some features may not work correctly.
cerezPolitikasi.s3Intro: You can manage, delete or disable cookies through your browser's settings menu. Guidance for common browsers:
cerezPolitikasi.s3Warning: Disabling essential cookies may cause the site to malfunction.

faq.q1: Which businesses is CheckRezerve suitable for?
faq.a1: Any business that works on an appointment or reservation basis — restaurants, cafés, hairdressers, barbers, spas, beauty salons, fitness centers, hotels and event venues — can use CheckRezerve. Its flexible structure can easily be configured regardless of sector.
faq.q2: How does the prepayment system work?
faq.a2: Your customer pays the amount you set with their credit card when making a reservation. This amount is held securely until the reservation date. When the customer comes, the payment is released or refunded; when they don't show, it stays with your business. All transactions are secured with 3D Secure infrastructure.
faq.q3: Do I pay a commission per reservation?
faq.a3: No. CheckRezerve works with a fixed subscription model. No matter how many reservations you take, there is no additional commission or deduction. You pay nothing beyond your monthly or annual plan fee.
faq.a4: After completing your registration, you can enter your business information, services, and working hours and be active the same day. No technical knowledge required; our support team is by your side at every step.
faq.q5: How do my customers make reservations?
faq.a5: A custom reservation page is created for you. You can add this link to your website, Instagram profile, or WhatsApp. Your customers can request reservations through this page 24/7.
faq.q6: How is reservation cancellation or modification managed?
faq.a6: You can edit, cancel, or move any reservation to a new time through the panel. When a change is made, an automatic notification is sent to your customer.
faq.q7: I have multiple employees — can I add them all to the system?
faq.a7: Yes. In Professional and Enterprise plans, you can define per-employee calendars. Each staff member's own availability can be managed separately.
faq.a8: All your data is transmitted over encrypted connections and stored on secure servers. Maximum care is taken to protect personal data in accordance with GDPR. Your data is never shared with third parties under any circumstances.

faq.sssQ1: How do I register my business?
faq.sssA1: Registering with CheckRezerve is very easy. Click the 'Get Started Free' button on the homepage, enter your business name, type, phone and email. Our expert team will contact you the same day and set up your system free of charge.
faq.sssA2: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial. No credit card required. At the end of the trial, you can choose the plan that suits you if you want to continue; otherwise, no charges are made.
faq.sssA3: No, CheckRezerve charges zero commission or deductions per reservation. You pay only a fixed monthly or annual subscription fee. All reservation revenue belongs entirely to you.
faq.sssA4: Track all your reservations through your dedicated panel. View, confirm, cancel or reschedule appointments with daily, weekly and monthly views. Conflict alerts prevent double bookings.
faq.sssA5: Yes. Automatic SMS and email notifications are sent to customers for reservation confirmations, reminders and cancellations. You can customize notification timing and content from the panel.
faq.sssA6: Restaurants, cafés, hairdressers, barbers, spas, beauty salons, fitness centers, yoga/pilates studios, hotels, event venues, psychologists, dentists and many more sectors can use CheckRezerve. It works with sector-specific fields and terminology.
faq.sssA7: CheckRezerve subscription fees can be paid by credit card or bank transfer. Additionally, you can eliminate no-show losses with the prepayment feature at booking. All payments are secured with 3D Secure infrastructure.
faq.sssA8: API integration support is available on the Enterprise plan. You can integrate CheckRezerve with your existing website, mobile app or POS system. Contact our team for detailed API documentation.
faq.sssA9: All data is transmitted over TLS/SSL encrypted connections. Database access is restricted through service role keys. Your personal data is protected with KVKK and GDPR-compliant infrastructure. Your data is never shared with third parties.
faq.sssA10: Our Enterprise plan allows you to manage multiple branches from a single panel. Separate working hours, staff lists and reservation calendars can be defined for each branch. Compare performance with branch-based reporting.
faq.sssQ11: What is the cancellation and refund policy?
faq.sssA11: You can cancel your subscription anytime — no commitment required. For prepaid annual plans, the remaining months are refunded. You set the rules for reservation cancellations — free cancellation window, deduction rate and more are managed from the panel.
faq.sssQ12: How do I get technical support?
faq.sssA12: Contact our live support team weekdays 09:00-18:00 via the panel, email or WhatsApp. Our average response time is 4 hours. Enterprise plan users get priority support and a dedicated account manager.
faq.sssCtaDesc: Our team is happy to help.

features.heroTitle: Every Tool to Grow Your Business, Right Here
features.heroSubtitle: From AI-powered confirmation to real-time tracking, from prepayment to CRM — all dimensions of reservation management in one platform.
features.feat1Desc: The moment a reservation is completed, our AI engine automatically calls the customer. It verbally confirms or cancels the reservation using natural language — all conversations are recorded.
features.feat1Item2: Natural language conversation and confirmation flow
features.feat1Item3: Voice confirmation recording viewable in the dashboard
features.feat1Item4: Reduces no-show rate by up to 60%
features.feat2Desc: Not every customer wants to talk to AI. CheckRezerve gives customers the choice between AI or a real operator. No call is missed with instant notification on the receptionist screen.
features.feat2Item1: AI / human routing based on customer preference
features.feat2Item2: Instant call notification on receptionist dashboard
features.feat3Desc: Which tables are occupied, how many people are inside, when will peak hours be reached? Keep your business's real-time pulse on a single screen.
features.feat4Desc: Data-driven management instead of intuitive decisions. Track all your business metrics with daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
features.feat5Desc: Customers can choose the service type and expert themselves when making a reservation. Offer a professional experience with staff photos, bios, and availability calendars.
features.feat5Item1: Service category selection (massage, hair, spa, etc.)
features.feat6Desc: Customers can select their preferred table or cabin from an interactive map. Smart suggestions automatically prevent conflicts and gaps.
features.feat7Desc: Know every customer. From allergy information to seating preferences, from past visits to birthdays — every detail is on record.
features.feat8Desc: Put customers who don't show up without notice in the past. Collect card details at booking time; automatically charge no-shows.
features.feat8Item1: Secure card detail collection at booking time
features.feat8Item3: Automatic charge in case of no-show
features.faq1Q: Is the AI voice confirmation feature subject to an additional fee?
features.faq1A: No. AI voice confirmation is included in all plans. The human agent feature is available in Pro and Enterprise plans.
features.faq2Q: Which cards are accepted in the prepayment system?
features.faq2A: All domestic and foreign credit cards are accepted. All transactions are carried out with 3D Secure infrastructure.
features.faq3Q: Can we share reports with our team?
features.faq3A: Yes. Reports can be exported in Excel and PDF format. Additionally, panel access can be defined for multiple users.
features.faq4Q: Can I use the application from a mobile device?
features.faq4A: Yes. The CheckRezerve web application is mobile-responsive. Native applications for iOS and Android are under development.
features.ctaTitle: Try All Features Free for 14 Days
features.ctaSubtitle: No credit card required. Setup completed in minutes.

accountDelete.title: Account Deletion
accountDelete.intro: You can follow the steps below to permanently delete your account created in the CheckRezerve mobile application.

mobileSteps.title: Via Mobile Application
steps: Tap the "Profile" tab at the bottom right.
Go to "Account Security" > "Account Settings" > tap "Permanently Delete My Account".
Complete the verification steps to confirm the action.

deletedData.title: Deleted Data & Retention Period
items: Profile, reservation, and contact data are permanently deleted immediately.
Some non-personal data (such as reservation records) may be retained for 2 years due to legal obligations.

consequences.title: Consequences of Deletion
items: Account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.
All information associated with the deleted account becomes inaccessible.
Accumulated points and benefits will be deleted.

screenSteps.title: Step-by-Step Screenshots
screenSteps.subtitle: Review the step-by-step instructions below for a smoother account deletion experience.

step1.label: Step 1
step1.desc: Open the Profile tab and access the Settings menu.

step2.label: Step 2
step2.desc: Navigate to Account Security > Account Settings.

step4.label: Step 4
step4.desc: Confirm the deletion. This action cannot be undone.
